TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.TITLE: AI Agent Campaigns
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.DESCRIPTION: Launch an AI Agent over a group of contacts and track each campaign's progress.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.REFRESH_ERROR: The table could not be refreshed.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EMPTY_HINT: Create one with the “Add campaign” button or bulk-assign an AI Agent from Contacts.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search by name, AI Agent or channel…
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.DELETE_CONFIRM: Its active follow-ups will be cancelled (they stop sending) and the rest will stay unlinked under “All”. Delete campaign
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.CONTINUOUS_CREATED: Campaign "{name}" created. To receive contacts, create an automation that uses it.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.LAUNCH_CONFIRM: Batch campaigns enroll the contacts the segment or label has right now and start sending; continuous ones start receiving contacts from automations. Start the campaign
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.SAVED_HINT: Campaign saved. Nothing is sent until you press «Start».
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.SAVED_BANNER: Saved: it does not enroll anyone or send messages until you start it.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EDIT_SUCCESS: Changes saved. It stays Saved until you start it.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EDIT_ERROR: The campaign could not be opened for editing.
TRACKING_CAMPAIGNS_VIEW.EDIT_ONLY_SAVED: Only a Saved campaign can be edited: this one has already started.

FILTER_DESC.intent_replied: Contacts who replied at least once since the follow-up was created (counts even if they replied before the first message).
FILTER_DESC.intent_interested: A keyword rule with the Interested action marked it (e.g. the AI Agent wrote #interested at the end of its message).
FILTER_DESC.intent_appointment: A keyword rule with the Booked action marked it (e.g. the AI Agent wrote #booked at the end of its message).
FILTER_DESC.intent_objective: The follow-up goal was achieved; marked as success and sending stops.
FILTER_DESC.intent_paused_rule: Paused by a keyword rule (e.g. #pause) and still paused. They can be resumed.
FILTER_DESC.intent_cancelled_rule: Permanently cancelled by a keyword rule (e.g. #cancel).
FILTER_DESC.ctrl_pending: With their next message scheduled. They may have already received earlier attempts; they stay here until the next one is sent.
FILTER_DESC.ctrl_completed_replied: Exhausted attempts and got a reply.
FILTER_DESC.ctrl_failed: The follow-up could not run. Hover the ℹ️ on the status to see the exact cause.
FILTER_DESC.del_delivered: The channel confirmed the last message reached the contact (or was already read).
FILTER_DESC.del_sent: The message left the system, but the channel hasn't confirmed it reached the contact yet.
FILTER_DESC.del_failed: The channel couldn't deliver the last message (invalid number, block, or other rejection).

FAILURE.WINDOW_CLOSED: WhatsApp 24h window closed and no template configured: could not send.
FAILURE.SEND_FAILED: Could not send the message: the channel rejected the send or the conversation could not be created/found.
FAILURE.TEMPLATE_PARAMS: The template requires parameters that could not be resolved.
FAILURE.UNKNOWN: Execution error with no recorded detail.

ENTRIES.EMPTY: Nobody has been enrolled yet. In a continuous campaign, contacts arrive through the "Add to campaign" automation action.

REASON.active_tracking: already has an active AI Agent
